messages:
maya (security): Heads-up: planning a narrow RBAC tweak so our build runners can decrypt archived SAST/DAST bundles for post-processing. Want eyes on audit logging, canary approach, and triage attachment flow. @sam @jason
sam (infra): quick clarify: are we granting key-level decrypt or a broader keyring role? prefer least-privilege.
maya (security): key-level only. proto: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scans/cryptoKeys/sast-key --member=serviceAccount:ci-builders@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter```
jason (platform): could we instead use short-lived grant via STS+IAM conditions? that would avoid persistent perm.
maya (security): we tried STS last quarter but runners can't reliably refresh tokens for nightly backfills. Operational cost high. proposing: add binding, 48h canary in a test project, 90-day review, and logs-based alerting.
sam (infra): for audit: enable Cloud KMS crypto operations in Cloud Audit Logs + export to BQ. Also emit a structured log from the decrypt wrapper with fields: scan_id, artifact_sha256, decrypt_request_id, runner_id. That way scanbot can join.
jason (platform): scanbot can consume the manifest if it's uploaded to our manifests bucket at /manifests/{scan_id}. Need a writer SA and a webhook secret for verification.
scanbot: automated: I can auto-attach manifests to the Jira triage ticket if the manifest contains keys: scan_id, scanner, artifact_hash, decrypt_audit_id. I verify webhook signature using HMAC SHA256.
maya (security): rollback plan? if anything odd, we should be able to revoke quickly.
sam (infra): emergency steps: 1) remove IAM binding (fast) 2) add deny policy for that SA on the key (immediate) 3) rotate key if exfil suspected. I'll draft the exact gcloud commands in the runbook.
jason (platform): recommend a logs-based alert: if decrypts from that SA exceed 15/hour outside the maintenance window, page security on-call. Also flag decrypts from unexpected IPs/regions.
maya (security): retention: compliance requests 400-day retention for KMS access logs. sam, can we maintain that in the BQ export?
sam (infra): yes we can. will create infra ticket to update sinks and retention.
maya (security): canary plan: enable binding in scans-test project for 48 hours, run synthetic decrypt jobs (10 runs), verify logs + manifest attachment, then flip for prod. jason, can you make the CI test that performs a decrypt + manifest upload and asserts scanbot attached?
jason (platform): yes, I'll add a minimal pipeline that uses the test SA, decrypts a small fixture, writes manifest, and polls for Jira link.
scanbot: automated: noted. when manifest appears I'll post confirmation to the triage board and include the decrypt_audit_id.
maya (security): ownership: I'll own the security review and signoff, sam owns infra rollout, jason owns platform integration.
sam (infra): I'll open INFRA-9123 for the log export & alert, and INFRA-9124 for the canary PR. Estimated PR by EOD tomorrow.
jason (platform): I'll open PLAT-778 for the CI test and a small docs PR describing the manifest schema.
maya (security): thanks team. action items summarized: sam: infra tickets + runbook commands, jason: CI + manifest schema, maya: triage playbook + review cadence. I'll post a follow-up when canary is ready. :thumbsup:
scanbot: automated: will post back to this thread when the first manifest is observed in test project (will include link).
